card.name: Linking words in treatment regimen headings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with" or "where", or a following space, right after a treatment, therapy or regimen name in dosing and indication sections. It marks the spot where the combination, setting or dose is about to be named.

modes.label: With after therapy
modes.description: The word "with" right after a therapy or treatment phrase, introducing a combination partner.
modes.example: TRUDA QLEX in combination with RT<< with>> or without cisplatin.

modes.label: Space before dose or week
modes.description: A blank space right before a dose amount or a week or day number in a dosing line.

modes.description: Words like "where" or a letter ending a condition name, in a spot that leads into a clause about the setting.
